description: Na₂Ti₂O₅ is Chalcostibite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three TiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two TiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with five TiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.44 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent TiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.87 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent TiO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.87 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms.
